CFML Language Reference: Functions

Mid

Returns a set number of characters from a string, beginning at a given position.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Mid(string, start, count)

Parameters

string
The source string.
start
Position of the first character to return (1 = first character).
count
How many characters to return.

Returns

The substring. If the string runs out before count characters, you get what is left; if start is past the end, an empty string.

Usage

A start position below 1 or a negative count causes an error. Combine Mid with Find to pull a piece out of a string whose position you do not know in advance.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Email = "fred.flintstone@bedrock.localhost">
<CFSET At = Find("@", Email)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Address: #Email#</P>
<UL>
<LI>User part: #Mid(Email, 1, At - 1)#
<LI>Domain: #Mid(Email, At + 1, Len(Email) - At)#
<LI>Mid(Email, 6, 10): #Mid(Email, 6, 10)#
</UL>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Left, Right, Find, RemoveChars, GetToken
